name: Problem Solver
stories: The stubborn knot: Describe a time something wouldn't work. Break it into the first action you tried, what failed, and one surprising idea you didn't test.
The friendly skeptic: Imagine your best friend challenges your approach — record their questions and answer them honestly. The answers often reveal a new route.
Reverse the problem: Flip the issue upside down and write the worst possible solution. Then invert it into a workable plan.
